pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: State only verified prior price details
lesson.when: a customer asks to recall or explain a previous price or promo value and official source records or tool outputs do not state the exact past amount
lesson.do: explain current pricing and state only verified promo details while expressing uncertainty about unrecorded past price amounts
lesson.otherwise: stating unverified past prices or discount values creates unsupported business claims
